book.title: Kiristoos Yisa Tarjamonnante Kinin Yittsaa Wannisin Thaapoono Birono Warqanno

content: Barjo Naana

“Barjo naana” hamayse wonin eldhoadettsi Barjo Imbaa hamin dohon nashimmakkonam wona kinin imonam shedee! Wodi gon Barjo naanane. Ogo goynka peen kodar dohoono eeno Barjoam konin dhesaamonna woamaar dhesehe.
Isa nashonato, keeda wodi Barjo naanane; os birante har wonin maatenam akar dhesadhadehe. Ko dahaannaar Kiristoosin niven wodanka, kisa dantanam wonin haapenna kidettsi wonin maatenam dhesooda dhese.
Kiristoosdar qaabe hayea wul kidi gaza kinin dahaadettsi yiam kida gazinse.
Seeson waadadhea wul Barjo yigginam kida kottse. Seeso waadiminta Barjo yigginam kottsinta hamintane.
Kiristoos eensa seesonam shiishana kinin nivonam dheseeda dhese. Seeso kisa qolehe.
Kiristooska dehea eedi wul seeso waadadhehe; seeson waadadhea eedi wul Kiristoosam haapadehe, pir dhesadehe.
Naanato, hayyear yeam ko taysabhoode; Kiristoos tipa kinin dohondettsi, tipamonam waadadhea eedi tipane.
Harrna hambhidianna, seeso waadadhea Seethaankalankane. Seethaan birara yedayse seeso kida waadadhe. Ogonante Barjo Naasayn nivoono Seethaansa waadimanam kaysanane.
Barjokala adhadhaa wul seeso waadadhehe. Harrna hambhidianna, Barjosa dantano kisa iinte konin dohonnane; pir Barjokala kinin adhadhonna seeso waadadhana damehe.
Tipamonam waadadhimabee imbanaasam nashima wulbe Barjokalankatehe. Barjo naanabee Seethaan naanabe ogoka keda dhesime.
Kinka Kiam Kiam Nashadhen Goyno
Birara yedayse yenin qansoono ergeno yinne: “Kinka kiam kiam wo nashe” hamaynone.
Seethaansa muldha maataa, indanaasaam deesaa Qaaveeldettsi maata zaskehe. Harrna kiam ki deesaa? Kisa waadimano siya konin dohonnabee indanaasasa waadimano tipa konin dohonnabene.
Imbanaanato, peen kodar dohoono eeno yeam konin jibbenka targadheebhode.
Wodi imbanaanaam wonin nashonna, dembhira sadandar wonin sagonam dhesooda dhese. Nashimmakkoysa qolmaa dembhinte ki dahade.
Imbanaasam jibbea wul eediam deesaane. Eediam deesaar rooro wul lay dehea sada kisa qolmonam dheseeda dhese.
Kiristoos wona hamayse sadan yinnonam saskayse kinin imonna, nashimmakko har konin dohonam wodi dhesidine. Wodiar imbanaanana hamayse sadan wonnonam saskayse ima woam ko zaske.
Ko dahaannaar peen kodar koymo yisa dahaa eedi gaalea imbanaasam shedayse kina ki burqadhaamma, Barjosa nashimmakkono kisa iinte hamin ko dee?
Naanato, wosa nashimmakkono gonbee waadimabeka ko dee; apoka bish ko dahabhoode.

Wosa woylammoar wodar konin pirden wodanka, goninkalanka wonin dohonam ogo wosa nashimmakkonka woda dhese; kisa birantear wosa woylaminam woda ukunsise. Barjoar wosa woylamindara sagine; yer wulam dhesa ki dhese.
Isa nashonato, wosa woylammo wodar ko pirdaamma Barjo birante ooshimbhe qolma woda dee.
Barjosa upsinam toolaynabee kiam wozisenam waadadhaynabe wonin dohonna, wonin misken wulam kikalanka haapooda haape.
Barjosa upsino Naasa kintea Yesus Kiristoosdar woylamin wonin qajoadettsibee kinin giyondettsi kinka kiam kiam wonin nashoadettsibene.
Barjosa upsinam toolea kanka kida dee; Barjoar kanka kida dee. Barjo wonka kinin dohonam wonin dhesayno wona kinin imon Manpasinkane.
